item.title: Sales round up: Lambs to £1,500/head at Carlisle, record calf price at Gisburn, £5,000 raised for charity, dairy record set at Betham
item.description: Champion lamb sell for £1,500/head at Carlisle IT was a clean sweep for Messrs Storey, Haltwhistle, at Carlisle's Christmas show and sale of prime lambs. Their champions were the winning pen of four from the any other breed class, 50kg Dutch Texels, which went on to sell for a prime lamb record of £1,500/head to Mr Alam, Lancashire Direct Halal, Blackburn. item.title: What might the future of UK farming really look like and why these next few years matter
item.description: Talk to almost any farmer right now and there is a familiar feeling behind the conversation; a sense that everything is stacked against you.
